files.shabads/20/10341.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":10341,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":896,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":13,"first_verse_id":114649,"last_verse_id":114661,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":114649,"page_no":896,"line_no":114649,"gurmukhi":"ਚੌਪਈ ॥","translit_en":"chauapiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Chaupaee"},"pu":{"ss":"ਚੌਪਈ:"}}},{"verse_id":114650,"page_no":896,"line_no":114650,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਹਿ ਵਹੁ ਸਾਹਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"ek tirayeh vahu saeh nihaariyo ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਇਕ ਇਸਤਰੀ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਨੂੰ ਵੇਖਿਆ"}}},{"verse_id":114651,"page_no":896,"line_no":114651,"gurmukhi":"ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਮੁਖੀ ਕੇ ਨਿਕਟ ਉਚਾਰਿਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"ei(n)dhr mukhee ke nikaT uchaariyo ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the pretty lady had fallen for the Shah, she exclaimed, ‘Oh, god Indra Mukhi,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਤੇ (ਉਸ ਨੇ) ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਮੁਖੀ ਕੋਲ ਕਿਹਾ,"}}},{"verse_id":114652,"page_no":896,"line_no":114652,"gurmukhi":"ਐਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭੋਗ ਕੋ ਪੈਯੈ ॥","translit_en":"aaiso purakh bhog ko paiyai ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਅਜਿਹਾ ਪੁਰਸ਼ ਭੋਗ ਲਈ ਮਿਲ ਜਾਏ"}}},{"verse_id":114653,"page_no":896,"line_no":114653,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਹਿਤ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਬਲਿ ਜੈਯੈ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"praan sahit taa ke bal jaiyai ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘If I get such a person for making love, I could sacrifice my life on him.’(7)"},"pu":{"ss":"ਤਾ ਉਸ ਉਤੋਂ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਕ ਨਿਛਾਵਰ ਕਰ ਦੇਈਏ ॥੭॥"}}},{"verse_id":114654,"page_no":896,"line_no":114654,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਨੁ ਰਾਨੀ ਤਿਹ ਬੋਲਿ ਪਠੈਯੈ ॥","translit_en":"sun raanee teh bol paThaiyai ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਰਾਣੀ! files.shabads/20/10355.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":10355,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":898,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":114726,"last_verse_id":114728,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":114726,"page_no":898,"line_no":114726,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥","translit_en":"dhoharaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dohira"},"pu":{"ss":"ਦੋਹਰਾ:"}}},{"verse_id":114727,"page_no":898,"line_no":114727,"gurmukhi":"ਚੋਰ ਏਕ ਚਤੁਰੋ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਮ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਵ ॥","translit_en":"chor ek chaturo rahai bairam taa ko naav ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There was a thief whose name was Bairam."},"pu":{"ss":"ਬੈਰਮ ਨਾ ਦਾ ਇਕ ਚਾਲਾਕ ਚੋਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਸੀ।"}}},{"verse_id":114728,"page_no":898,"line_no":114728,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਤ ਸੇਖਜਾਦੋ ਰਹੈ ਬਸੈ ਕਾਲਪੀ ਗਾਵ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"jaat sekhajaadho rahai basai kaalapee gaav ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By caste he was a sheikh and used to live in the village of Kaalpi.( 1)"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਾਤਿ ਦਾ ਉਹ ਸ਼ੇਖਜ਼ਾਦਾ ਸੀ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲਪੀ ਪਿੰਡ ਵਿਚ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਸੀ ॥੧॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":10354,"next":10356}}
files.shabads/20/10356.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":10356,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":898,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":114729,"last_verse_id":114733,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":114729,"page_no":898,"line_no":114729,"gurmukhi":"ਚੌਪਈ ॥","translit_en":"chauapiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Chaupaee"},"pu":{"ss":"ਚੌਪਈ:"}}},{"verse_id":114730,"page_no":898,"line_no":114730,"gurmukhi":"ਚੌ ਚੋਬਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਨਾਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"chau chobaa gireh basatr banaayo ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"(ਉਸ ਨੇ) ਚਾਰ ਚੋਬਾ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੰਬੂ ('ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ') ਬਣਵਾਇਆ"}}},{"verse_id":114731,"page_no":898,"line_no":114731,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਨ ਕੋ ਉਮਰਾਵ ਕਹਾਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"aapan ko umaraav kahaayo ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He adorned four tier clothes and posed himself as an aristocrat (and he announced),"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਮੰਤ ਅਖਵਾਇਆ।"}}},{"verse_id":114732,"page_no":898,"line_no":114732,"gurmukhi":"ਮੈ ਹਜਰਤਿ ਤੇ ਮਨਸਬ ਲਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"mai hajarat te manasab layo ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਮੈਂ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹ ('ਹਜਰਤਿ') ਤੋਂ ਮਰਾਤਬਾ ਹਾਸਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":114733,"page_no":898,"line_no":114733,"gurmukhi":"ਪਲਵਲ ਦੇਸ ਪਰਗਨਾ ਭਯੋ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"palaval dhes paraganaa bhayo ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘The Raja has granted me an honour and (the territory of) Palwal is my protectorate.(2)"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਤੇ ਪਲਵਲ ਦੇਸ (ਮੇਰਾ) ਪਰਗਨਾ ਹੈ ॥੨॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":10355,"next":10357}}
files.shabads/20/10357.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":10357,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":898,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":114734,"last_verse_id":114736,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":114734,"page_no":898,"line_no":114734,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥","translit_en":"dhoharaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dohira"},"pu":{"ss":"ਦੋਹਰਾ:"}}},{"verse_id":114735,"page_no":898,"line_no":114735,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਛੁ ਉਪਚਾਰੁ ਕੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥","translit_en":"taa ke kachh upachaar ko keejai hiradhai bichaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘That is why I am going to undertake some welfare work,"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਉਸ ਨੇ) ਉਸ ਦੇ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਲਈ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਕੁਝ ਵਿਚਾਰ ਕੀਤਾ"}}},{"verse_id":114736,"page_no":898,"line_no":114736,"gurmukhi":"ਤਹਾ ਚਲਨ ਕੋ ਸਾਜੁ ਸਭ ਲੀਜੈ ਮੋਲ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"tahaa chalan ko saaj sabh leejai mol sudhaar ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘And to perform the task, I will have to act in good manners.’"},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿ ਉਥੋਂ ਦੇ ਚਲਨ ਨੂੰ ਧਨ ਖ਼ਰਚ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਲਿਆ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":10356,"next":10358}}
files.shabads/20/10358.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":10358,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":898,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":114737,"last_verse_id":114741,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":114737,"page_no":898,"line_no":114737,"gurmukhi":"ਚੌਪਈ ॥","translit_en":"chauapiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Chaupaee"},"pu":{"ss":"ਚੌਪਈ:"}}},{"verse_id":114738,"page_no":898,"line_no":114738,"gurmukhi":"ਸਕਲ ਗਾਵ ਕੇ ਬਨਿਕ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥","translit_en":"sakal gaav ke banik bulaae ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"(ਉਸ ਨੇ) ਪਿੰਡ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਬਨੀਏ ਬੁਲਾ ਲਏ"}}},{"verse_id":114739,"page_no":898,"line_no":114739,"gurmukhi":"ਸੌ ਕੁ ਰੁਪੈਯਾ ਤਿਨ ਚਟਵਾਏ ॥","translit_en":"sau k rupaiyaa tin chaTavaae ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He called all the people of the village and to entertain them he spent about one hundred rupees."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਰਹਾ ਦੀ ਆਓ ਭਗਤ ਲਈ ਸੌ ਕੁ ਰੁਪਇਆ ਖ਼ਰਚ ਕੀਤਾ।"}}},{"verse_id":114740,"page_no":898,"line_no":114740,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹਿਯੋ ਤ੍ਯਾਰ ਸਾਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥","translit_en":"kahiyo tayaar saaj kar dheejai ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"(ਉਸ ਨੇ) ਕਿਹਾ ਕਿ ਸਾਰੇ ਸਾਜ-ਸਾਮਾਨ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰ ਲਵੋ"}}},{"verse_id":114741,"page_no":898,"line_no":114741,"gurmukhi":"ਅਬ ਹੀ ਰੋਕ ਰੁਪੈਯਾ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੪॥","translit_en":"ab hee rok rupaiyaa leejai ||4||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He asked them to get ready and arrange some money."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਤੇ ਹੁਣ ਹੀ ਨਕਦ ਰੁਪਇਆ ਲੈ ਲਵੋ ॥੪॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":10357,"next":10359}}
files.shabads/20/10359.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":10359,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":898,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":114742,"last_verse_id":114744,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":114742,"page_no":898,"line_no":114742,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥","translit_en":"dhoharaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dohira"},"pu":{"ss":"ਦੋਹਰਾ:"}}},{"verse_id":114743,"page_no":898,"line_no":114743,"gurmukhi":"ਰੋਕ ਰੁਪੈਯਨ ਖਰਚਿ ਕੈ ਲੀਜੈ ਮੁਹਰ ਬਟਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"rok rupaiyan kharach kai leejai muhar baTai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He had intended to collect the rupees and then convert them into goldcoins,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਨਕਦ ਰੁਪਏ ਖ਼ਰਚ ਕੇ ਮੋਹਰਾ ਵਟਾ ਲੈਣੀਆਂ ਚਾਹੀਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ"}}},{"verse_id":114744,"page_no":898,"line_no":114744,"gurmukhi":"ਭਰ ਬਰਦਾਰੀ ਕੋ ਘਨੋ ਖਰਚਨ ਹੋਇ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੫॥","translit_en":"bhar baradhaaree ko ghano kharachan hoi banai ||5||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So that the high expenses could be met.(5)"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਕਿਉਾਂਕਿ) ਬਰਾਦਰੀ ਦਾ ਭਾਰ ਬਹੁਤ ਹੈ, (ਇਸ ਲਈ) ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਖ਼ਰਚ ਕਰਨਾ ਹੈ ॥੫॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":10358,"next":10360}}
files.shabads/20/10360.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":10360,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":898,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":114745,"last_verse_id":114749,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":114745,"page_no":898,"line_no":114745,"gurmukhi":"ਚੌਪਈ ॥","translit_en":"chauapiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Chaupaee"},"pu":{"ss":"ਚੌਪਈ:"}}},{"verse_id":114746,"page_no":898,"line_no":114746,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਤਿਨ ਕਹੀ ਸੁ ਬਨਿਕਨ ਮਾਨੀ ॥","translit_en":"jo tin kahee su banikan maanee ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਨੇ ਜਿਵੇਾਂ ਕਿਹਾ, ਉਸੇ ਤਰ੍ਰਹਾ ਬਨੀਏ ਨੇ ਕੀਤਾ"}}},{"verse_id":114747,"page_no":898,"line_no":114747,"gurmukhi":"ਕਛੂ ਸੰਕ ਚਿਤ ਬੀਚ ਨ ਆਨੀ ॥","translit_en":"kachhoo sa(n)k chit beech na aanee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Shah acted the way he was asked, he did not get any doubt in his mind,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਤੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਕਿਸੇ ਤਰ੍ਰਹਾ ਦਾ ਸੰਦੇਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਲਿਆਂਦਾ।"}}},{"verse_id":114748,"page_no":898,"line_no":114748,"gurmukhi":"ਮੁਹਰੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਆਨਿ ਕਰ ਦਈ ॥","translit_en":"muharai adhik aan kar dhiee ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"(ਉਸ ਨੇ) ਬਹੁਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਮੋਹਰਾ ਲਿਆ ਕੇ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ।"}}},{"verse_id":114749,"page_no":898,"line_no":114749,"gurmukhi":"ਤਸਕਰ ਡਾਰਿ ਗੁਥਰਿਯਹਿ ਲਈ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"tasakar ddaar guthariyeh liee ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Brought lot of gold-coins and handed over to that swindler.(6)"},"pu":{"ss":"ਚੋਰ ਨੇ (ਉਨ੍ਰਹਾ ਨੂੰ) ਗੁੱਥੀਆਂ ਵਿਚ ਪਾ ਲਿਆ ॥੬॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":10359,"next":10361}}

files.shabads/20/10435.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":10435,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":907,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":115178,"last_verse_id":115182,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":115178,"page_no":907,"line_no":115178,"gurmukhi":"ਚੌਪਈ ॥","translit_en":"chauapiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Chaupaee"},"pu":{"ss":"ਚੌਪਈ:"}}},{"verse_id":115179,"page_no":907,"line_no":115179,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾ ਸੌ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਹਿ ਸਮੁਝੈਯਹੁ ॥","translit_en":"taa sau kahiyo nirapeh samujhaiyahu ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ (ਕਿ ਕਿਸੇ ਤਰ੍ਰਹਾ) ਤੂੰ ਰਾਜੇ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝਾਕੇ"}}},{"verse_id":115180,"page_no":907,"line_no":115180,"gurmukhi":"ਤੁਮ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਪਹਿ ਠਹਿਰੈਯਹੁ ॥","translit_en":"tum jogee aapeh Thahiraiyahu ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She told him, ‘Acting like a yogi, you make Raja to understand,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਨੂੰ ਜੋਗੀ ਦਸਕੇ।"}}},{"verse_id":115181,"page_no":907,"line_no":115181,"gurmukhi":"ਕ੍ਯੋ ਹੂੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਹਿ ਮੋਰਿ ਘਰ ਲ੍ਯਾਵਹੁ ॥","translit_en":"kayo hoo(n) nirapeh mor ghar layaavahu ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਵੇਾਂ ਕਿਵੇਾਂ ਰਾਜੇ ਨੂੰ ਘਰ ਵਲ ਮੋੜ ਲਿਆਉਣਾ ਹੈ।"}}},{"verse_id":115182,"page_no":907,"line_no":115182,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਮੁਖ ਮਾਗਹੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੬੦॥","translit_en":"jo kachh mukh maagahu so paavahu ||60||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘And bring him round to come home and you will get whatever you desire.’(60)"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਕੁਝ ਵੀ ਮੁਖੋਂ ਮੰਗੋਗੇ, ਉਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰੋਗੇ ॥੬੦॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":10434,"next":10436}}

files.shabads/20/10438.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":10438,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":907,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":115191,"last_verse_id":115193,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":115191,"page_no":907,"line_no":115191,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥","translit_en":"dhoharaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dohira"},"pu":{"ss":"ਦੋਹਰਾ:"}}},{"verse_id":115192,"page_no":907,"line_no":115192,"gurmukhi":"ਜਬ ਰਾਨੀ ਐਸੇ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਤਬ ਰਾਜੈ ਮੁਸਕਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"jab raanee aaise kahiyo tab raajai musakai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When Rani said so, Raja smiled and asked,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਦ ਰਾਣੀ ਨੇ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਰਹਾ ਕਹਾ ਤਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੁਸਕਰਾਇਆ (ਅਤੇ ਕਹਿਣ ਲਗਾ ਕਿ)"}}},{"verse_id":115193,"page_no":907,"line_no":115193,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਤਾ ਸੋ ਬਾਤੈ ਕਰੀ ਸੋ ਤੁਹਿ ਕਹੋ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥੬੩॥","translit_en":"jo taa so baatai karee so tuh kaho sunai ||63||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘Whatever he had talked, you let me know.’(63)"},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਜੋ (ਤੇਰੀਆਂ) ਗੱਲਾ ਹੋਈਆਂ ਸਨ, ਉਹ ਤੂੰ (ਮੈਨੂੰ) ਕਹਿ ਕੇ ਸੁਣਾ ॥੬੩॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":10437,"next":10439}}
files.shabads/20/10439.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":10439,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":907,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":115194,"last_verse_id":115198,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":115194,"page_no":907,"line_no":115194,"gurmukhi":"ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥","translit_en":"savaiyaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Savaiyya"},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਵੈਯਾ:"}}},{"verse_id":115195,"page_no":907,"line_no":115195,"gurmukhi":"ਹੈ ਬਨ ਕੋ ਬਸਿਬੋ ਦੁਖ ਕੋ ਕਹੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਤੂ ਸੰਗ ਕਯੋਂ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"hai ban ko basibo dhukh ko kahu su(n)dhar too sa(n)g kayo(n) nibahai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘’Aye, Pretty Woman, to live in the jungle is very wearisome, how would you tolerate?"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਰਾਜੇ ਨੇ ਹੋਰ ਕਿਹਾ) ਹੇ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ!
